import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int n, t;
    static int[] left_, right_, vis;
    static char[][] a, b;
    static int[][] da, db;
    static Cap[][] cap;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;

    static class Pos {
        int x, y, num;
        Pos(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
        Pos(int x, int y, int num) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.num = num; }
    }

    static class Cap {
        int[] arr = new int[1000];
        int cnt;
        int flag;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        a = new char[n][n];
        b = new char[n][n];
        da = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(da[i], INF);
        cap = new Cap[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                cap[i][j] = new Cap();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) b[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Pos p = new Pos(i, j);
                    bfs1(p);
                }

        int id = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j])) {
                    int k = b[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) cap[i][j].flag = 1;
                    cap[i][j].cnt = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
                        cap[i][j].arr[l] = id++;
                }

        g = new ArrayList[1000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        left_ = new int[1000];
        right_ = new int[1000];
        vis = new int[1000];

        id = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j])) {
                    int k = a[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Pos p = new Pos(i, j, id++);
                        bfs2(p);
                    }
                }

        System.out.println(matching(id - 1));
    }

    static void bfs1(Pos s) {
        Queue<Pos> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        int i = s.x, j = s.y;
        da[i][j] = 0;
        qu.add(s);
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            Pos p = qu.poll();
            i = p.x; j = p.y;
            if (a[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && da[i - 1][j] > da[i][j] + 1) {
                da[i - 1][j] = da[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < n && da[i + 1][j] > da[i][j] + 1) {
                da[i + 1][j] = da[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && da[i][j - 1] > da[i][j] + 1) {
                da[i][j - 1] = da[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < n && da[i][j + 1] > da[i][j] + 1) {
                da[i][j + 1] = da[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(Pos s) {
        Queue<Pos> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        db = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(db[i], INF);
        int i = s.x, j = s.y;
        db[i][j] = 0;
        qu.add(s);
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            Pos p = qu.poll();
            i = p.x; j = p.y;
            if (db[i][j] > t) continue;
            if (a[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (cap[i][j].flag != 0) {
                if (db[i][j] <= t && db[i][j] <= da[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= cap[i][j].cnt; k++)
                        g[s.num].add(cap[i][j].arr[k]);
                }
            }
            if (db[i][j] >= da[i][j]) continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && db[i - 1][j] > db[i][j] + 1) {
                db[i - 1][j] = db[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < n && db[i + 1][j] > db[i][j] + 1) {
                db[i + 1][j] = db[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && db[i][j - 1] > db[i][j] + 1) {
                db[i][j - 1] = db[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < n && db[i][j + 1] > db[i][j] + 1) {
                db[i][j + 1] = db[i][j] + 1;
                qu.add(new Pos(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean dfs(int u) {
        if (vis[u] != 0) return false;
        vis[u] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = g[u].get(i);
            if (left_[v] == -1) {
                left_[v] = u;
                right_[u] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (dfs(left_[v])) {
                left_[v] = u;
                right_[u] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int matching(int m) {
        Arrays.fill(left_, -1);
        Arrays.fill(right_, -1);
        boolean done;
        do {
            done = true;
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++)
                if (right_[i] == -1 && dfs(i))
                    done = false;
        } while (!done);
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++)
            if (right_[i] != -1) cnt++;
        return cnt;
    }
}
